name: Povorcitinib
sort_evidence: Povorcitinib has a CHMP positive opinion (Povofortay, 2026-09-17) with no EC decision yet and remains under FDA review, with HS and prurigo nodularis Phase 3 trials active (NCT06212999, NCT06516952) (https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/povofortay).
